definitions.n_hops: Number of explicit subquestions in the chain.
definitions.n_effective_doc_hops: Number of contiguous evidence-document runs after collapsing adjacent hops that use the same doc_id. This estimates retrieval/context switches.
definitions.n_effective_type_hops: Number of contiguous local/web modality runs after collapsing adjacent hops with the same hop_type.
definitions.n_unique_docs: Number of unique source documents used anywhere in the chain.
definitions.local_to_web_transition: A hop_type transition from L to W between adjacent hops.

method.exact_normalization: casefold, strip punctuation, replace markers/numbers/company names
method.approx_cluster_rule: same hop number bucket plus token Jaccard >= 0.82, or Jaccard >= 0.55 and SequenceMatcher >= 0.88
method.note: This is an estimate intended to collapse near-duplicate phrasings, not a semantic entailment judgment.
